title: Realistic demonstration — real open data + a real local LLM
brief_ref: e6-realistic-demo-instructions-03-nov-2026-2113.md; brief.md §7.2 (added alongside E1-E5, does not replace them)
status_note: Owner-approved scope addition. The offline deterministic core E1-E5 stays the primary proof; E6 adds real-world relevance with all model outputs frozen so the experiment stays reproducible.

dataset.name: UK Cabinet Office — Expenditure over £25,000, February 2013
dataset.encoding: cp1252 (Windows-1252; the raw file is NOT valid UTF-8 — byte 0x92 at offset 617)
dataset.attribution_required: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
dataset.non_pii: Payments to organisations only; no private-individual data. No personal data added.
dataset.n_statement: 143 source records, of which 129 carry an amount (14 empty rows reported, not dropped)
dataset.data_quality_note: Three source data-quality facts are reported verbatim and none is silently fixed. (1) The file has 143 non-header source records, of which 129 carry an amount and 14 are entirely empty rows (every field blank); the 14 empty rows remain verbatim in the frozen CSV and are reported, not dropped, and b_count = count(amount) = 129 counts amount-bearing records. (2) The source uses two distinct Supplier Type spellings — 'Gov Dept' and 'Government Department' — for what is evidently one category; E6 reports both verbatim rather than merging them, since merging would be a shell-side data edit, which brief §5 forbids. (3) Amount includes one negative row (-115912.64, a credit/refund), kept verbatim.

model.name: llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M
model.l5_connection_status: active (already registered in L5; not re-declared by E6)
model.decoding: greedy / temperature 0 (L5's vendored ollama backend sets options.temperature=0 by default)
model.call_path: L5 vendored transport.call against the L5-selected local connection; loopback only
model.network_policy: zero non-loopback calls; LoopbackGuard permits 127.0.0.1 and blocks+counts everything else

qafiya_bindings.dataset: spend (normalized deterministically from the frozen CSV; snake_case fields)
qafiya_bindings.derivation_grammar: FUNC(field) [where col='val'] with FUNC in {sum,avg,count,min,max} (qafiya_core.derivations, closed set)
qafiya_bindings.headline_meaning: Total February 2013 Cabinet Office Programme expenditure over £25,000 (the largest of the three Expenditure Type categories).

compose_prompt.role: The model fills ONLY the COMPOSE step (interpret the prompt, propose the answer in prose). It never authors a verified number.
compose_prompt.user_question: From the Cabinet Office February 2013 spend-over-£25,000 data, what was the total Programme expenditure, and which supplier type received the largest total spend?
compose_prompt.model_receives: the row-level (expenditure_type, supplier_type, amount) triples from the frozen CSV, plus the question

honesty_guardrails.auditability_claims_computed_over: frozen data + frozen transcript, NOT the model's correctness
honesty_guardrails.show_divergence: model-stated number vs Qafiya-verified value, side by side; a divergence is a FEATURE (the binding recomputes the real number deterministically regardless of the prose)

cost_honesty.actual_metered_meaning: not metered — there is no provider BILLING meter for a local model. ollama reports token USAGE (prompt_eval_count/eval_count), which is recorded in the transcript, but a local $0 declared price is a user declaration, not a measured cost.
cost_honesty.l5_raw_actual_cost_usd_note: L5's cost.actual_cost_usd computes declared-$0-price x ollama token usage = 0.0. E6 records that raw value AND presents actual_metered_cost_usd=null per the cost-honesty guardrail, with the reason — the divergence is shown, not hidden.

honesty_guardrails.e5_limit_carried: The shell proves integration + audit, NOT that the model understood intent or that its prose is true (brief §8).

stability_check.freezes: all k transcripts as raw artifacts
stability_check.reports: token-level variance across the k responses AND confirmation that every auditability claim is INVARIANT to the prose
stability_check.invariance_rule: if a claim would change with model output, it is not an auditability claim and is moved out of the verified set

headline_result_recomputed_by_spine: Provenance coverage %, evidence source-rows, the verified aggregates recomputed from the FROZEN CSV by an independent parser, action records, replay completeness, declared-vs-metered cost, the model-vs-verified divergence, and stability invariance — all recomputed from the frozen data + transcript, never from the model's correctness and never requiring a model to re-run.
